mapper.sql: general_ledgers.id AS id, general_ledgers.date AS `date`, (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1) AS branchId, (SELECT name FROM branches WHERE id = (SELECT branch_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1)) AS branchName, general_ledgers.apply_to_id AS applyToId, general_ledgers.reference AS reference, general_ledgers.is_adj AS adj, COALESCE(general_ledgers.deposit_type, (SELECT `type` FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1), 0) AS `type`, general_ledgers.is_approve AS status, IFNULL(general_ledgers.recurrence, 0) AS isRecurrence, general_ledgers.note AS note, IFNULL(4000, 0) AS exchangeRate, general_ledgers.deposit_type AS depositType, (SELECT account_codes FROM chart_accounts WHERE id = (SELECT chart_account_id FROM general_ledger_details WHERE general_ledger_id = general_ledgers.id LIMIT 1)) AS COA, DATE_FORMAT(general_ledgers.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(general_ledgers.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy
FROM general_ledgers LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = general_ledgers.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = general_ledgers.modified_by

mapper.sql: general_ledger_details.id AS id, general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id AS journalEntryId, chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id AS chartAccountTypeId, general_ledger_details.chart_account_id AS `chartAccountId`, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' - ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, general_ledger_details.memo AS description, general_ledger_details.class_id AS `classId`, classes.name AS `className`, general_ledger_details.type AS `type`, general_ledger_details.debit AS `debit`, general_ledger_details.credit AS `credit`, general_ledger_details.customer_id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, general_ledger_details.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, general_ledger_details.employee_id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeName, general_ledger_details.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, (SELECT SUM(debit) - SUM(credit) FROM general_ledgers gl INNER JOIN general_ledger_details gld ON gl.id=gld.general_ledger_id WHERE is_active=1 AND is_approve=1 AND chart_account_id = chart_accounts.id LIMIT 1 ) AS balance, COALESCE((SELECT reference FROM pay_bills WHERE gl_id = general_ledger_details.general_ledger_id LIMIT 1), '') AS invoice, general_ledger_details.type AS listType

FROM general_ledger_details LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = general_ledger_details.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN classes ON classes.id = general_ledger_details.class_id LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = general_ledger_details.customer_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = general_ledger_details.vendor_id LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = general_ledger_details.employee_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = general_ledger_details.company_id LEFT JOIN branches ON branches.id = general_ledger_details.branch_id
